These lessons begin with careful observation, local context, community knowledge, and respect for where teachings come from.

## What you will practise

- notice relationships between place, season, materials, and design;
- record observations before choosing an idea; and
- use community sources respectfully and name where teachings came from.

## Lessons

::: {.ter-path-grid}
::: {.ter-path-card}
### Grandmother Moon, the Seasons, and the Turtle's Back

Learn about the 13 Grandmother Moons, seasonal change, the turtle-shell teaching, and the distinction between community teachings and astronomical measurements.

[Open the lesson](grandmother-moon-seasons.qmd)
:::

::: {.ter-path-card}
### Land Lettermark

Connect observation of the land, personal identity, Indigenous ways of knowing, being, and doing, and visual communication through a lettermark design process.

[Open the lesson](land-lettermark.qmd)
:::
:::

## Before you begin

Begin with the community source and local context. Treat the resources as starting points for learning, not replacements for Elders, Knowledge Keepers, language speakers, artists, or community teachers.
